<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Send a conversation message"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/chat/conversations/{conversationId}/messages"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



`content` and `attachmentUrl` are optional but at least one is
required. `attachmentUrl` must be an unused `/uploads/...` file owned
by the caller. For a PRIVATE conversation, the upload becomes
conversation-scoped and is readable only while the conversation remains
accessible to the viewer. A saved participant snapshot never grants
access. Current shared-family membership is checked again by the route.
This route requires server feature `directMessages`; it does not accept
encryption parameters.
